text: NCA learns one weight ada_d per standardised feature expected leave-one-accuracy soft nearest-neighbour rule maximal. Dij=∑dad2(xid−xjd)2D_{ij} = \sum_d a_d^2 (x_{id} - x_{jd})^2, case ii picks neighbour jj probability pij∝exp⁡(−Dij)p_{ij} \propto \exp(-D_{ij}), NCA maximises mean probability picking neighbour class. Without regularisation weights grow without bound noise variables can get large weights, add small penalty λ∑dad2\lambda \sum_d a_d^2 λ=0.01\lambda = 0.01.
code: nca_weights <- function(X, y, lambda = 0.01, maxit = 200) {   y <- as.integer(factor(y)); n <- nrow(X); p <- ncol(X)   same <- outer(y, y, "==")   sq <- lapply(seq_len(p), function(d) outer(X[, d], X[, d], "-")^2)   objective <- function(a) {     D <- Reduce(`+`, Map(function(s, w) w^2 * s, sq, a))     diag(D) <- Inf     K <- exp(-(D - apply(D, 1, min)))     P <- K / rowSums(K)     p_i <- rowSums(P * same)     grad <- vapply(seq_len(p), function(d) {       2 * a[d] * sum(p_i * rowSums(P * sq[[d]]) - rowSums(P * same * sq[[d]]))     }, numeric(1))     list(value = -mean(p_i) + lambda * sum(a^2), gradient = -grad / n + 2 * lambda * a)   }   opt <- optim(rep(1, p), function(a) objective(a)$value,                function(a) objective(a)$gradient,                method = "L-BFGS-B", control = list(maxit = maxit))   abs(opt$par) }  # standardised design matrices, scaled with the training data design <- function(train, test, vars) {   f <- stats::reformulate(vars)   Xtr <- stats::model.matrix(f, train)[, -1, drop = FALSE]   Xte <- stats::model.matrix(f, test)[, -1, drop = FALSE]   mu <- colMeans(Xtr); s <- apply(Xtr, 2, sd); s[s == 0] <- 1   list(train = scale(Xtr, mu, s), test = scale(Xte, mu, s)) }  class_scores <- function(probs, truth, lev) {   onehot <- outer(as.character(truth), lev, "==") * 1   pred <- lev[max.col(probs, ties.method = "first")]   c(accuracy = mean(pred == as.character(truth)),     brier = mean(rowSums((probs - onehot)^2))) }  nca_knn <- function(train, test, endpoint, vars, k) {   X <- design(train, test, vars)   a <- nca_weights(X$train, train[[endpoint]])   Xtr <- sweep(X$train, 2, a, "*"); Xte <- sweep(X$test, 2, a, "*")   D <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(Xtr, Xte)))[seq_len(nrow(Xtr)), nrow(Xtr) + seq_len(nrow(Xte)), drop = FALSE]   lev <- levels(factor(train[[endpoint]]))   y <- as.character(train[[endpoint]])   probs <- t(apply(D, 2, function(d) {     nn <- order(d)[seq_len(k)]     as.numeric(table(factor(y[nn], levels = lev))) / k   }))   class_scores(probs, test[[endpoint]], lev) }

code: cbr_scores <- function(model, test, k) {   ev <- model$evaluate(test, k = k)   c(accuracy = ev$accuracy, brier = ev$brier) }  run_cv <- function(df, methods, folds = 5, repeats = 2, seed = 1) {   set.seed(seed)   res <- list()   for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {     fold <- sample(rep(seq_len(folds), length.out = nrow(df)))     for (f in seq_len(folds)) {       train <- df[fold != f, ]       test <- df[fold == f, ]       for (m in names(methods)) {         res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.frame(method = m, t(methods[[m]](train, test)))       }     }   }   do.call(rbind, res) }  class_methods <- function(endpoint, vars, k = 10, logistic = TRUE) {   fml <- stats::reformulate(vars, endpoint)   rf <- function(train, type = NULL) {     m <- RFModel$new(fml, train, num.trees = 300)     m$fit()     if (!is.null(type)) m$set_distance_method("Proximity", proximity_type = type)     m   }   methods <- list(     "Gower" = function(train, test) {       m <- GowerModel$new(fml, train); m$fit(); cbr_scores(m, test, k)     },     "RF depth" = function(train, test) cbr_scores(rf(train), test, k),     "RF-GAP" = function(train, test) cbr_scores(rf(train, "rfgap"), test, k),     "NCA" = function(train, test) nca_knn(train, test, endpoint, vars, k)   )   if (logistic) {     methods <- c(list("Logistic regression" = function(train, test) {       m <- LogisticModel$new(fml, train); m$fit(); cbr_scores(m, test, k)     }), methods)   }   methods }  summarise_cv <- function(res, cols) {   out <- data.frame(method = unique(res$method))   for (cl in cols) {     out[[cl]] <- vapply(out$method, function(m) {       v <- res[[cl]][res$method == m]       sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean(v), sd(v))     }, character(1))   }   out }
